definitions.gloss: closing (of a curtain); end of a performance
definitions.explanation: the end of a theatrical performance when the curtain closes
the end or conclusion of a festival, sports season, or major event

examples.japanese: ⟦オリンピック→オリンピック：09899_orinpikku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{閉幕|へいまく}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{映画祭|えいがさい}→映画祭：30642_eigasai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{昨日|きのう}→昨日：00859_kinou⟧{閉幕|へいまく}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
{閉幕式|へいまくしき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{盛大|せいだい}→盛大：13644_seidai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: A grand closing ceremony was held.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大会|たいかい}→大会：03386_taikai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{閉幕|へいまく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{惜|お}しむ→惜しむ：09610_oshimu⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}かった→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Many people expressed regret at the tournament's closing.

examples.english: The curtain closed while the applause continued without stopping.

notes:
{閉幕|へいまく} literally means "closing the curtain" ({閉|へい} = close + ⟦{幕|まく}→幕：12518_maku⟧ = curtain). Originally a theater term, it is now widely used for the end of any major event.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {閉幕式|へいまくしき}: closing ceremony
- {閉幕|へいまく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧: to reach the closing
- {閉幕|へいまく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to close, to end (suru verb)

USAGE:
Used for formal or large-scale events: ⟦オリンピック→オリンピック：09899_orinpikku⟧, {万博|ばんぱく} (expos), ⟦{映画祭|えいがさい}→映画祭：30642_eigasai⟧ (film festivals), ⟦{国会|こっかい}→国会：02761_kokkai⟧ (parliament sessions). Not used for casual gatherings or everyday endings.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{開幕|かいまく}→開幕：08174_kaimaku⟧: opening (antonym)
- ⟦{終了|しゅうりょう}→終了：02563_shuuryou⟧: ending (more general, less ceremonial)
- ⟦{閉会|へいかい}→閉会：23962_heikai⟧: closing of a meeting or assembly
